## Foods & dishes
- [[BLEnD]] (`Arabic_Egypt`, SemEval-2026): 105 food questions, 576 food answer clusters.
- [[ArabCulture]]: 265 items, 56 food (40 Egypt-specific) + 7 food-adjacent.
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 24 dishes, 13 Egypt-specific (rank 11). [[WorldCuisines]]: 38 dishes, 9 Egypt-specific.
- [[RecipeDB2]]: ≈320 recipes (samples only held). [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]]: 200 user-tagged recipes.
- [[FmLAMA]]: 4 dishes (66 rows). [[ArSyra Food and Culture]]: Egypt claimed.

## Ingredients & food composition
